make_movie_whole_scenario: make a movie of the whole Nocturne scenario using scenario.getImage with target positions drawn
make_movie_around_vehicle: make a movie centered around a vehicle with the view rotating to follow the source vehicle
make_movie_cone_view: make a movie using getConeImage to render a cone-shaped view around a moving vehicle
make_image_scenario: make a single image of the whole Nocturne scenario and save it as a PNG file
make_image_features: make a single image of the visible state features using getFeaturesImage around a vehicle
